statements.t: We believe our business strategy of product diversity, reduced cost structure and prudent hedging will decrease earnings volatility and drive peer-leading Free Cash Flow per share growth.”

The drilling and completion capital budget is expected to be in the range of $325 to $350 million during the fourth quarter of 2026, as the company is targeting a $1.2 billion drilling and completion capital budget for 2026.

For more information on Antero’s hedge portfolio, including basis hedges, please see the presentation titled “Hedges and Guidance Presentation” on the Company’s website or Antero’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
An updated presentation will be posted to the Company's website before the conference call.

The Company has not provided projected net cash provided by operating activities or a reconciliation of Adjusted Free Cash Flow to projected net cash provided by operating activities, the most comparable financial measure calculated in accordance with GAAP.

The Company is unable to project net cash provided by operating activities for any future period because this metric includes the impact of changes in operating assets and liabilities related to the timing of cash receipts and disbursements that may not relate to the period in which the operating activities occurred.
The Company is unable to project these timing differences with any reasonable degree of accuracy without unreasonable efforts.
